guide_solution: Matching (a) The culture of a society can easily give a complete picture of life and living of the specific society. (b) In order to know the culture of any society we need to study different arenas of life, the behaviour of people and the tradition of that society. (c) The modes of behavior and tradition in any particular society are not always similar to other society. (d) Language , eating habits etc. in Bangladeshi culture are different from those of British culture. (e) The difference which exist between different culture are considered cultural differences.
